name: Rice Boat From Outside the River
summary: This painting is from a set of 50 depicting the different types of boats that cluttered the Pearl River. It shows a boat carrying rice from other provinces. Natives of Guangdong routinely referred to other provinces as 'outside the river'. Paintings such as this were mass-produced as souvenir items.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
